notes: *any* was read as the indefinite subject pronoun realizing the verb's person and number under rule 17, not as an added lexical subject noun; rule 17's added case governs a lexical noun such as *men*.
The italic *chastisement* and *any more* answer to no morpheme (rules 44, 30); the margin's *though I offend not* was read and set aside (rule 38).
